title: Declaration of name and address of manufacturer, packer or importer

checks.requirement: Conspicuous name and complete address of manufacturer; if manufacturer is not packer, both manufacturer and packer; imported package requires importer
Identifying mark or inscription enabling consumer to identify manufacturer/packer/importer is sufficient
Principal display panel must contain name and complete address of packer or importer in India

complete_address_definition.factory_case: Postal address at which factory is situated
complete_address_definition.other_case: Street name, premises number if any, and either city and State or PIN Code sufficient to identify and locate the entity

name_requirement: Actual corporate name, or if not incorporated, business name used in India
